cards.name: Sad Hamster
cards.caption: *sad violin plays*
cards.flavor: Feb 2024: Alto the hamster, edited with huge teary eyes, set to a sad violin song.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image, a TikTok frame of the grey big-eyed 'sad hamster' (an edit of Alto, owned by Instagram's monyo_melo) staring at the camera on a white background.

cards.name: Side Eye Cat
cards.caption: Bombastic side eye
cards.flavor: Late 2023: Mr. Fresh, an orange stray on a Chinese cat-feeder livestream, side-eyes you.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image of Mr. Fresh, the orange tabby from the Hello Street Cat feeder-cam livestream, giving the camera a suspicious side-eye.

cards.name: Pesto the Penguin
cards.caption: Bigger than his parents
cards.flavor: Sept 2024: a giant, fluffy king penguin chick at Sea Life Melbourne outgrew his parents.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main photo of Pesto, the huge brown fluffy king penguin chick at Sea Life Melbourne Aquarium, beak up, with adult king penguins behind him.

cards.name: Ok I Pull Up
cards.caption: Hop out at the after party
cards.flavor: Don Toliver's 'After Party' plays while JoeJoe the capybara rides shotgun. Ok I pull up.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image, a video frame of JoeJoe the capybara sitting in a car's passenger seat with the door open (from a Crazy Cody's Creatures clip).

cards.name: Huh Cat
cards.caption: Huh?
cards.flavor: 2023: Ben, a chubby cat meowing for food, got a 'huh?' dub and became pure confusion.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image of Ben the chubby white-and-black cat, eyes wide and mouth open mid-'huh?', cropped above the image's HUH? caption.

cards.name: Gegagedigedagedago
cards.caption: Where did you come from?
cards.flavor: 2023–24: a Roblox-faced chicken nugget sings a gibberish 'Cotton Eye Joe' on TikTok.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image of the Roblox-face chicken nugget in a cowboy hat, standing in the middle of a desert highway.

cards.name: Dancing Toothless
cards.caption: Vibing to Driftveil City
cards.flavor: Dec 2023: animator Cas van de Pol's 2D Toothless danced to a Pokémon song. Forever.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image, a frame of Cas van de Pol's 2D animation of Toothless (How to Train Your Dragon) standing upright mid-dance in a jungle clearing.

cards.name: Pedro Raccoon
cards.caption: Pedro pedro pedro
cards.flavor: Spring 2024: a raccoon spinning in a circle video to Raffaella Carrà's 'Pedro' remix.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image, the baby raccoon waving a paw inside the round TikTok circle video on a black background.

cards.name: Low Taper Fade
cards.caption: The meme is still massive
cards.flavor: Jan 2024: ericdoa sang 'Imagine if Ninja got a low taper fade.' Then Ninja got one.
cards.art: Real image: the viral photoshop from KYM's gallery of streamer Ninja with a curly-top low taper fade, hand on chin, in a grey hoodie.

cards.name: Smurf Cat
cards.caption: We live, we love, we lie
cards.flavor: Aug 2023: Nate Hallinan's 2011 'Smurf Sighting' art went viral on TikTok as шайлушай.
cards.art: Real image: Nate Hallinan's 'Smurf Sighting' concept art in the square TikTok crop: a blue cat-faced creature in a white mushroom cap, carrying a snail on a stick through a mossy forest.

cards.name: Sigma
cards.caption: Erm, what the sigma?
cards.flavor: The 'sigma male' grindset got Patrick Bateman as its face. Gen Alpha made it a word.
cards.art: Real image: film still from American Psycho (2000), Patrick Bateman (Christian Bale) walking into the office in headphones, the frame behind the 'Patrick Bateman Walking' sigma edits.

cards.name: Rizz
cards.caption: Unspoken rizz
cards.flavor: Oxford's 2023 Word of the Year. Its face: Shrek's knowing smile from Shrek the Third.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image for 'Shrek Rizz', a still from Shrek the Third (2007) of Shrek looking up with a sly, knowing smile.
